title: Knave Table File
description: Schema for Knave procedural table JSON files. Each file groups related tables from one section of the source booklet.

attribution.example: Knave, copyright Ben Milton (questingbeast.com / questingblog.com). Licensed under CC BY 4.0.

usage_note.description: File-level note on roll conventions or source quirks.

roll.description: Die/mechanic used to roll this table, e.g. '1d20', '1d100', '1d20 (roll twice)'

usage_note.description: Optional note on how or when to use this table

entries.description: Either a flat array of result strings (most tables), objects with min/max/result for range tables, or objects with roll/name/effect for the spell list
